script: Welcome to the Dropshipping Career Course. In this course you will learn how to research, launch and run an online store that sells products without holding stock, in about ten to fifteen hours a week. This course is for beginners who can use a phone, a computer and the internet. You do not need a business degree or money to buy stock. You do need patience, honesty and a willingness to test ideas. Many online adverts promise quick money. This course teaches a method, not a guaranteed income. Results depend on your product, your effort and the market. The course has fourteen chapters. Each one ends with a practical task. Study one chapter, finish the task, then move on.
glossary: dropshipping, supplier, ROAS, CPA, stop-loss, Shopify
